details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: GSSAPI client state retained between authentication
     attempts
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-106555.patch: reset the GSSAPI client state in
       sshd before each authentication attempt so state left by a partially
       completed GSSAPI exchange cannot be used by a later attempt
     - CVE-2026-106555
   * SECURITY UPDATE: GSSAPI credentials stored without successful GSSAPI
     authentication
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-106553.patch: only store delegated GSSAPI
       credentials when GSSAPI user authorization succeeded
     - CVE-2026-106553
   * SECURITY UPDATE: shell metacharacters accepted in command-line user names
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-106583.patch: also reject '$' and '\' in a
       user name given on the ssh command line, and drop the trailing-backslash
       special case, so it cannot inject into expanded ProxyCommand, Match exec
       and similar commands
     - CVE-2026-106583
   * SECURITY UPDATE: compressed packets inflating beyond the maximum packet
     size
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-106585.patch: fail uncompress_buffer() once the
       decompressed output reaches PACKET_MAX_SIZE, in packet.c
     - CVE-2026-106585
